results.segment: This is your Council Tax demand for the property at Studio 3, which is in valuation band C. The amount payable for the year is £2,390.62, and your account reference is 083/13678/W.
The balance is payable in 10 instalments of £239.06 on the first of each month, as set out in the schedule printed with this notice.
The first instalment of £239.06 is to be paid by 23 September 2026. Where a Direct Debit is held, collection is made on that date and no action is needed.
Any change in your circumstances — for example someone moving in or out — is to be notified to us at your earliest convenience so that the bill can be corrected.
Details of discounts, exemptions and how bands are set are printed on the reverse of this notice.

If you think your property is in the wrong band you can ask the Valuation Office to review it; this notice remains payable while a review is open. Appeals about liability go to the Valuation Tribunal.
